description: Agent Grants: submit a progress or final report to the funder with the records it summarizes, as supplied: the report with the grant, its kind (progress or final), the first and last day it covers, the currency, each deliverable it claims complete with the day claimed, the total spent it claims and each category total it claims; the records with the milestone records, each with its id, deliverable, status and day completed, and the expense records with their currency and each expense with its id, category, amount and day spent. The signed report gives the report and the records supplied, each deliverable claimed paired with its milestone record and read as shown complete or not, each claimed completion day against the record, the total spent and each category total claimed against the expense records dated inside the report period, and counts them, and names a misreported report: a deliverable claimed complete that the milestone records do not show complete, another completion day or currency than the records and more spent in total or in a category than the expense records hold; then less spent than the records hold and a deliverable the records show complete in the period left out, with the fix for each and what would change the verdict. A claim with no records supplied for it, a record with no completion day where the report claims one, expenses with no day where the report states a period, or a report that claims nothing leaves the report unverified. Deliverables pair by their words with plurals folded, days read as days and amounts compare to the cent in one currency. This reads a report to a funder against the grant’s own records: wever_event-report-check reads a post-event report against the registration list, the agenda as run and the speaker records, wever_rely-report-check reads a service’s reliability report for buyers, and wever_goal-progress-check reads an agent’s claimed progress toward a goal against the records behind it, while the report check reads a grant report’s deliverables, amounts spent and dates against the milestone and expense records it summarizes and judges no work’s merit. Verdict grant_report_misreported, grant_report_partial, grant_report_unverified or grant_report_faithful. POST /api/grant-report-check. Reads the grant records supplied in the call and returns a signed report with the verdict, the evidence read, the findings with their fixes, and what would change the verdict; it reads consistency between documents only: it never applies for a grant, awards one, disburses or moves any money, or judges the merit of an applicant, a project, or a funder’s decision, only whether the records agree with each other and with the terms they were written under, and the records stay in the report, with no network request, fetch, message, payment or external write. Agent Grants reads a grant’s records for consistency between documents: a grant application, a proposed budget, an award letter or grant agreement, milestone records, disbursement records, spending records, a progress or final report and a closeout record, each against the call or guidelines, the terms in the call or award, the application as submitted, the schedules in the award, the approved budget, the records it summarizes or the award terms it should agree with. Beside it, the conditional payments rail tools such as wever_conditional-create create, fund, cancel and report on payments held against conditions between parties, keeping state and moving money, and the Job Records tools such as wever_job-cost-brief read the records of paid work orders, while this family keeps no state, moves nothing, commissions no work and reads the grant records in the call against each other and against the terms they were written under. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-grants-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-grants/.
